data.name: Improved Shifting Companion
data.description: A chameleon adept's animal companion improves its ability to change shape. It can use wild shape, as a druid of half the hunter's level, to gain the effects of beast shape I. Unlike a druid's wild shape, this ability does not improve to encompass larger or smaller animals or elementals.
